utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: My sweet 91-year-old great-grandma teaching me a song.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It's so beautiful. Chad looked it up and listened to it. You ready?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh wait, okay. Okay, let me try by myself.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I know you kids today can't sit still for five minutes, but you have to focus. Your generation is always looking for the fast forward button, but music takes patience. Don't look away!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I was just adjusting my seat, Grandma. I'm actually really trying to learn this.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's great, you got that much. Yeah. And now pause like you got feeling. No, don't stop! Keep your hands on the keys. Do it again. Now!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Wait, I messed it! My fingers are getting tired, can we just—

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I said do it again. Don't argue with me, just play. Stop complaining about your fingers and hit the C-sharp.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm trying, but it feels like you aren't even listening when I say I need a second to breathe.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, that'll be beautiful. Now when you hear it, it'll help you learn it. Just keep playing.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm so proud. That's so fun! I just want to keep playing this song.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I am too. That's a classical. That's classical music. You're doing so good! I'm so proud of you! Well, just keep doing it. Ain't no sense not getting it in your head.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oh, you— it goes so fast and it took like an hour to— I know.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Isn't that a beautiful tune? I love
